ChapterOneRules.Name: Enable Chapter 1 rule support
ChapterOneRules.Hint: Makes AK5e Chapter 1 helpers and condition markers available in this World. This does not replace D&D5e's built-in death-saving-throw workflow.

AssetLibrary.Title: AK5e Asset Library
AssetLibrary.Hint: Register a named image or audio asset, then select or upload its file with Foundry's file picker. These mappings are stored in this World; the module ships with no artwork or audio.
AssetLibrary.RemoveConfirmation: Remove the "{label}" asset mapping? The actual file will not be deleted.
